message.content: Sure! To help you find your complaint’s current status, could you please share the complaint reference number or any details you received when you filed it? Once I have that, I’ll guide you through checking its progress.

But we might also want to provide instructions on how to check status online. There's no mention of needing to hand over to human. So we should respond with asking for complaint ID.
